opening.argument: The video gives viewers concrete steps for installing Google Camera on a Redmi Note 8 Pro, including downloading the app and configuration file, placing the file in the GCam folder, and loading it in the app. It then compares the results with the stock camera and acknowledges that the stock camera wins in some cases. Those qualifications matter: the speaker is demonstrating a tool and assessing its performance, not making an unqualified claim of improvement. The separate phone-skin discount is identified as sponsorship, an ordinary advertising element alongside the tutorial.

Now go into internal storage, GCam, Configs Paste it here. Now go back to gcam, double tap on empty area near the button and select the file we just pasted. Done!
